_doc: Measured on the real rig. tool.adapter_dz: 2026-10-28 hover (real_box.py hover, closed fingertips settled ~10 mm over the table at (-0.30, 0), (-0.24, 0), (-0.30, 0.06)): ruler gaps 5, 6, 6 mm vs 9.3, 9.6, 9.9 mm by the kinematics with -0.011 -> the hand 3.9 mm lower -> -0.0071 (the hand ~7 mm nearer the flange, higher, than the twin's model). The first estimate, -0.011, came from a long ruler in the ready pose (358 mm vs 346.9 mm), less precise.

scene_cam.method: 10-29: pitch, roll, height from the table plane in its depth (calib_board scene, levelled); x, y, yaw moved (+2.0 deg, (49.9, 3.9) mm about the world origin) so the A4 board's corners on its image land where the wrist calibration puts them (residuals ~5 mm): the scene camera expressed in the ARM's frame. Before it, the yellow tape was 36 mm from the wrist camera's position, after 12 mm.
